name: Indonesia
summary: Indonesia’s work in Papua links legal recognition, participatory mapping, and Indigenous governance against mounting extractive pressure.
featured_achievements: Historic recognition of 445,255 hectares for Yei territory in Indonesian Papua.
Participatory transboundary mapping covered 278,106 hectares into Papua New Guinea.
Gender-responsive mapping reached 50,268 hectares and 28,334 households.
